content.text: Raven leaves Cameron’s ranch after being accused of theft, while the North-West Rebellion erupts. Commissioner Irvine travels from Regina to Prince Albert, abandons Fort Carlton after Duck Lake, and helps defend the settlements. Mounted Police officers protect Battleford, Fort Pitt, Edmonton, and the western reserves, while Crowfoot restrains the Blackfeet from joining the rebels. Cameron recruits volunteers in Calgary, learns of a planned Piegan cattle raid, rides from Calgary toward the Big Horn and Sun Dance Trail, and discovers Raven’s scheme to stampede cattle into a ravine. Raven saves the herd but dies fighting Little Thunder. Cameron later arrests Eagle Feather and pursues Copperhead from the Blackfoot Reserve to Ghost River, where he escapes captivity with Jerry and captures Copperhead. The rebellion ends, and Cameron returns to Fort Calgary. Doctor Martin stays after declaring his love for Moira. Separate chapters follow spring and summer at the Clifford farm, where Amy’s relationship with Webb deepens amid farming, birds, flowers, bees, fishing, and family life.
